comparison.objective: Move a fragile egg clear and place a pot on a trivet; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile-object relocation and large-object placement versus precision tool use, fine rotary adjustment and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: No damaging contact, supported pot and safely released egg versus repeated non-bottoming stops with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Fragile clearance and placement do not test calibration or fastener manipulation. Candidate leaves rebound, overload, drift and locking-torque limits undeclared.
